meta.name: brandkit
meta.description: Premium brand-kit image generation skill for creating high-end brand-guidelines boards, logo systems, identity decks, and visual-world presentations. Trained for minimalist, cinematic, editorial, dark-tech, luxury, cultural, security, gaming, developer-tool, and consumer-app brand systems. Optimized for intentional logo concepting, refined composition, sparse typography, strong symbolic meaning, premium mockups, art-directed imagery, and flexible grid layouts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成高端品牌视觉指南与标识系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速创建品牌指南或标识系统
copy.tagline_en: Generate premium brand visual guidelines and identity systems
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create brand guidelines or identity systems

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成高端品牌指南图板，包含标志系统、应用场景和视觉世界。每张图板都像专业设计工作室出品，风格极简、有策略、可展示。
howto.when: 当你要求生成品牌指南、标志系统、视觉识别图板，或描述一个品牌（如工具、安全、奢侈品）时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一个开发者工具的品牌图板，3×3布局。
say.note: 会生成包含标志、UI、色调等9个面板的完整品牌系统。

say.text: 为一个AI助手品牌设计一个2×3的参考风格图板。
say.note: 会生成包含标志、浏览器、终端、氛围图等6个面板的迷你图板。

say.text: 为一个安全品牌生成一个标志概念，用盾牌和眼睛的隐喻融合。
say.note: 会生成一个基于隐喻融合的标志，并展示在品牌图板中。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates premium brand-guideline boards including logo systems, applications, and visual worlds. Each board feels intentional, minimal, strategic, and presentation-ready.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate brand guidelines, logo systems, identity boards, or describe a brand (e.g., developer tool, security, luxury).

say_en.text: Generate a 3x3 brand board for a developer tool.
say_en.note: Produces a full identity system with 9 panels.

say_en.text: Create a 2x3 reference-style board for an AI assistant brand.
say_en.note: Generates a mini-deck with logo, browser, terminal, etc.

say_en.text: Design a logo concept for a security brand using shield and eye metaphor fusion.
say_en.note: Creates a logo based on metaphor fusion, shown in the board.
